name: Affie Ellis
education: B.S. in political science and American Indian studies, University of Wyoming, 2000; J.D., University of Colorado Law School, 2007
background: Affie Ellis of Cheyenne served in the Wyoming Senate from 2017 to 2024, representing Senate District 8. The 2021–22 legislative directory listed her as an attorney, with a B.S. in political science and American Indian studies from the University of Wyoming (2000) and a J.D. from the University of Colorado Law School (2007). The same entry said she was married to her husband, Dennis, and had three children.

sources.name: Wyoming Trucking Association and Associated General Contractors of Wyoming, 2021–2022 Directory of the Sixty-Sixth Legislature
